scope: new NAS recovery behavior only; injected responses and virtual clock except isolated native process checks; no live requests

simulation.scope: synthetic responses and virtual elapsed time

cases.case: late connection succeeds after 6.42 seconds within the initial 10/20 second socket
three timeouts grow socket waits and backoff; the fourth attempt recovers beyond 120 seconds
106 attempts continue without a count cap; bounded history preserves cumulative counts
early polling and reopening a run preserve cooldown, counters and original receipt
one client lock prevents overlapping probes across different run IDs
Retry-After seconds exceed the usual 300 second backoff without premature retries
Retry-After HTTP date is respected for 503
DNS, connection, TLS and transient server faults remain resumable
legacy JSON is a successful connection but requires a compatible processor
known legacy MON HTML is reachable; login HTML is not a successful MON API
HTTP 200 malformed or unrelated JSON never becomes normal completion
a mismatched bootstrap version is rejected
valid bootstrap with no market data means connected, not analysis complete
401/403 require corrective action; explicit resume retains the same run and counts
corrupt journal is reported and never silently resets retry state
process loss preserves the attempt and resumes only after a new cooldown
explicit stop interrupts once and is not automatically retried
successful elapsed statistics increase the initial socket for the next run
journals contain only metadata, stay PHP-protected, and do not create launch grants
missing curl transports are an environment blocker, not a network failure or fake success
